exposure: Women undergoing autologous oocyte in vitro fertilization
cohort: The study included women who underwent oocyte donation or autologous oocyte in vitro fertilization.
finding: Newborns of oocyte donation patients had significantly lower birth weights compared to those from autologous oocyte pregnancies, and oocyte donation patients also had higher (but not significantly different) rates of hypertensive disease and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not different between the oocyte donation and autologous oocyte groups.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 36.9 weeks (OD group) vs. 38.1 weeks (AO group)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: 2,968 g (OD group) vs. 3,328 g (AO group)
